param_input_item.param_description: a uint8 vector of 32 bytes or 64 hexadecimal characters: secret key.
a uint8 vector of 24 bytes or 48 hexadecimal characters: unique per message for a given key (use crypto.random).
a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): content to encrypt.
a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): optional data authenticated but not encrypted; the same value must be given to decrypt.

param_output_item.param_description: a uint8 row vector: the 16-byte authentication tag followed by the ciphertext (same length as the plaintext).

description.p: crypto.aead.encrypt encrypts and authenticates a message with XChaCha20-Poly1305, an authenticated encryption scheme with a 256-bit key and a 192-bit nonce.

The nonce must be unique for every message encrypted with the same key; a repeated nonce breaks the security. Generate it with crypto.random(24) and store it alongside the encrypted message (it is not secret).
